basic_info.description: Discover this beautiful and quintessential San Francisco home. Enjoy stunning hardwood floors throughout and an open, spacious living room perfect for entertaining. This home offers three bedrooms, 2.5 baths, including a ground floor bedroom with a bonus kitchenette ideal for in-law living. The tranquil backyard with city views and private bedroom decks on both levels create serene retreats. Practical features include a one-car garage, basement storage, updated electrical systems, new sewer lateral, recent pest work, and a new downstairs furnace. Conveniently located near Glen Park BART, 280 freeway, and across from Glen Park School, this home is just a block from gourmet dining on Diamond Street. A rare city find, ready to become your new home!
